description: Turn supplied document evidence or raw operational text into a publication-ready workflow diagram with source references, clean vector SVG, Mermaid, Excalidraw scene, and interactive Studio deep link (`studioUrl`). INPUT SCOPE: Use reviewed written procedures only. Do not interpret scans, images, chart/diagram geometry or unlabeled arrows, and do not certify business procedures. Ask for reviewed written process text or source-backed clarification. HOW TO STRUCTURE TEXT INPUTS: Either pass `sources` (array of 1..60 verbatim chunks `{id, locator, excerpt}` where each excerpt is <= 2000 chars with exact numbers/actors/thresholds preserved) OR pass raw `text` and Unseen will automatically segment it into source chunks. EDITING GUIDANCE: For cosmetic/styling/annotation edits, edit the returned `<svg>` XML directly. For structural/topological edits (adding/removing nodes or rerouting branches), edit `spec` (VisualSpec JSON) and call `autofix_workflow` ($0 deterministic connector healing + fresh SVG/Mermaid/Excalidraw) or `revise_workflow`.

authToken.description: Optional session token (`utok_...`) obtained from `auth_verify_otp` or `auth_login` if not already supplied in the HTTP `Authorization: Bearer` header.

hostContext.description: Optional advisory context observed by the host agent

jobId.description: Optional job ID when resuming a workflow after clarification

priorAnswers.description: Answers to prior Unseen clarification questions when resuming a compilation

answer.description: User's answer to the clarification question

sources.description: Array of faithful source excerpts with locators from the input document (1..60 chunks, <=2000 chars each). Preserve exact thresholds, actors, and IF/ELSE branches.

text.description: Optional raw document or user text. If provided when `sources` is omitted or empty, Unseen automatically segments `text` into faithful `sources[]` chunks.

userGoal.description: The overarching operational goal or process description (e.g. 'Driver Onboarding SOP' or 'Vendor Risk Assessment')
